title: Trump says 'tariffs don't cause inflation' despite latest inflation numbers
summary: ABC report on the last pre-midterm CPI print: inflation at 3.7% and higher than at inauguration, diesel up sharply, and Republicans blaming others.

assertions.quote: Inflation is now at 3.7% compared to a year ago, up nearly 1% since President Trump took office.
But Trump denies it's a problem. -- But -- we don't have inflation
Why has it gone up? Because the Democrats' environmental regulations have not.

verdicts.note: The 2026 diesel spike tracks the Hormuz crude and distillate shock; fuel regulations predate the move and changed little.

Diesel sat at 3.49-3.82 through all of 2025 and Jan-Feb 2026 (below the 2022-2023 levels) under unchanged regulation, then jumped 32% in March 2026 (3.722 to 4.921) in the same month WTI rose 42%; the timing points to the oil shock, not to environmental rules that did not change that month.

assertions.quote: diesel, the fuel used to move almost everything you can buy, is up 72%

verdicts.note: Spring 2026 diesel peaked at 5.600 in May, below the prior record of 5.754 (Jun 2022); the series did set a record of 6.291 in Sep 2026, but not in spring.

assertions.quote: the lifeblood of America is diesel fuel. Everything you eat, consume, wear is delivered.
